entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: Human leader of the Northern branch of the Order on Otaria, killed by Kirtar's Mirari.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Military order on Otaria led in the north by Pianna.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land on Dominaria where Pianna lived.

entities.name: Lord Eagyn
entities.description: White dragon and lord of the Northern Order who rescued Pianna.

entities.name: Sergeant Kort
entities.description: Aven who raised Pianna as his daughter and led the Order after Eagyn.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: Aven lieutenant of the Order who found the Mirari and killed Pianna.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Magical orb found in the Cabal pits that fixated Kirtar.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction toward which Pianna took a moderate stance.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian publicly blamed for Pianna's death.

entities.name: Bretath
entities.description: Interim Captain of the Order after Pianna.

entities.name: Teroh
entities.description: Major who received the Sword of Leadership and was killed by Chainer.

entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: Commander who received the Sword of Leadership and command of the Order.

entities.name: Sword of Leadership
entities.description: Pianna's sword which crystallized alongside her but kept its sharpness.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Conflict during which Pianna ordered the villages protected.

events.summary: Pianna is orphaned when barbarian raiders massacre her family; she is saved by Lord Eagyn and given to Kort.
events.quote: She escaped the fate of her family by hiding in the chimney

events.summary: Pianna is nearly killed by wolves while protecting loggers and is saved by Order reinforcements.
events.quote: Were it not for the timely intervention of Order reinforcements

events.summary: Pianna travels to Krosa when Kirtar slaughters the forest's animals and orders him to withdraw.
events.quote: Pianna ordered Kirtar to withdraw his remaining men back to the citadel

events.summary: Pianna maps the attacks, finds they match Kirtar's route, and asks him to destroy the Mirari; he refuses and plots a coup.
events.quote: He instead organized a coup against Pianna by his fellow aven warriors

events.summary: Kirtar traps Pianna in solid crystal with the Mirari, killing her; the spell destroys the citadel and Kirtar.
events.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari to trap Pianna in a solid crystal, instantly killing her

events.summary: Bretath becomes interim Captain; the Sword of Leadership passes to Teroh, then Commander Eesha.
events.quote: Teroh was killed by Chainer before this could be effected
